# Raw
I snuck down to Ocean Avenue last night for the walk-through. The photo booth curtain's gone, so there's no ticket stash back there like we thought. Then I got caught behind the prize counter and got myself banned — my name's up on the Bulletin Board of Banishment now, right next to the Family Funtime Corporation company-picnic photos. And that's when it clicked: those aren't just souvenir shots, that's how they set me up in the first place. So we called a crew briefing in the secret arcade and made the call: drop the dune buggy, go for the mammoth. I need to send Gene the Bucket-Ball timing before we move.
